comment: Recall@5 / MRR / nDCG@5 floors for scripts/eval-check.js. Every production retrieval configuration MUST have a floor — the gate fails on a run with no committed baseline (v1.18.3). 'floors' covers the synthetic self-query corpus (all three configs currently measure 1.000; floors allow one lost query out of 12, fail on two). 'goldFloors' covers the hand-curated corpus in scripts/eval-gold.json (measured 2026-09-12: keyword 0.833/0.833/0.833, hybrid 0.833/0.750/0.772, hybrid+freshness 0.833/0.792/0.803). Update only after deliberate ranker improvements.
